source.title: Newton Zoning Ordinance, Chapter 30
source.textVerifiedAgainst: Official Chapter 30 'Last Amended 12-01-25' (City-published PDF at officialUrl), verified 2026-09-26: Sec. 3.1.2.A.2 and 3.1.3 table (SR1/SR2/SR3 pre- and on/after-12/7/1953 side/rear setbacks, lot coverage, sloped/flat height), Sec. 3.1.9 table and 3.1.9.A.1 (+0.02 pre-1953, conditioned on post-1953 setbacks and on not creating/increasing coverage or open-space nonconformity, not combinable with Sec. 7.8.2.B), Sec. 1.5.2.B/D (lot area, lot coverage incl. 2-ft overhang and 12/27/1922 garage exemptions), Sec. 1.5.3 (setback definition; averaging front-only), Sec. 1.5.5.A (FAR = gross floor area of all buildings / lot area). All implemented values match.
source.c67Review: Ordinance C-67 (10/20/2025, effective 3/1/2026) adds Sec. 1.5.7 Residential Facade Build Out Ratio (60% max), a new row after the FAR row in Sec. 3.1.3, and Sec. 7.8.2.B.2.l. It changes none of the setback, coverage, height or FAR values, definitions or inputs used here. The facade ratio itself is not screened: it needs front-elevation width and primary-frontage length, which HPP does not collect.

scope: Single-family detached dwellings in the Single Residence districts SR1, SR2, SR3 only. Every other district, building type, rear lots (Sec. 3.1.10), and special-permit relief are outside this screen.

citations.setbacks: Sec. 3.1.3 table, Principal Building Setbacks (side F, rear G); Sec. 1.5.3 (measurement). Front setbacks are not screened because Sec. 1.5.3 setback averaging can change the required front setback.
citations.lotCoverage: Sec. 3.1.3 table, Lot Coverage (max) B; Sec. 1.5.2.D definition (buildings, accessory buildings and roofed structures; overhangs up to 2 ft excluded). Sec. 1.5.2.D.2: coverage limits do not apply to a private garage accessory to a residence existing 12/27/1922; garage projects on houses built 1922 or earlier (or with unknown year) never get a definite over-limit result.
citations.height: Sec. 3.1.3 table, Principal Building Height (sloped roof 36 ft, flat roof 30 ft); Sec. 1.5.4 (measured from average grade plane to highest point of roof, with listed exclusions).
citations.far: Sec. 3.1.9 table and Sec. 3.1.9.A.1 (+0.02 for lots created before 12/7/1953 only if the new construction meets post-1953 setbacks); Sec. 1.5.5 (gross floor area measurement).
